description: Create an online knowledge test (exam-style quiz with scoring) on Wellemo from questions you write, and get a link to share. Participants take it in the browser without registration; the author sees every result, score and the hardest questions. Returns: take_url (public, send it to participants), edit_url (PRIVATE: lets the author edit the test and see results; opening it while logged in to Wellemo saves the test to the account) and results_url. Always show the user take_url and edit_url and tell them to keep edit_url private. Write questions in the language of the user. Up to 100 questions.

description.description: Short description shown before the start.

language.description: Interface language of the test page. Default: detected from the title.

correct.description: single: 0-based index of the correct option; multiple: array of 0-based indexes; truefalse: true or false.

items.description: ordering: items in the correct order (they are shuffled for participants).

type.description: single: one correct option; multiple: several correct options; truefalse; text: typed answer; number: numeric answer; matching: pairs; ordering: items in the right order; gap: answers in [square brackets] inside the text, e.g. "The capital of France is [Paris]".

show_answers.description: When participants see correct answers: end (after finishing, default), each (after every question), none.

time_limit.description: Time limit for the whole test in minutes, 0 or omitted = no limit.

name: create_knowledge_test
title: Create a knowledge test
